device.description: selected device. Returns statistic for the current device, given by :func:`~torch.cuda.current_device`, if :attr:`device` is ``None`` (default).
constraints: if device is not provided, it defaults to None

output.description: clock speed of the GPU SM in MHz (megahertz) over the past sample period as given by `nvidia-smi`

constraints: return type is an integer representing clock speed in MHz
